dz: 满洲摄政多尔贡在山海口之战中击败了顺王朝的叛军首领李子诚,使满洲人可以入关并征服北京都城.
de: Manchu regent Dorgon defeats rebel leader Li Zicheng of the Shun dynasty at the Battle of Shanhai Pass, allowing the Manchus to enter and conquer the capital city of Beijing.

t: 一支盖尔语爱尔兰军队在九年战争中成功伏击了克伦蒂布雷特战役中的一支英格兰部队.
te: A Gaelic Irish army successfully ambushes an English force in the battle of Clontibret during the Nine Years' War.
dz: 一支盖尔语爱尔兰军队在九年战争中成功伏击了克伦蒂布雷特战役中的一支英格兰部队.
de: A Gaelic Irish army successfully ambushes an English force in the battle of Clontibret during the Nine Years' War.

t: 康沃尔的理查德和他的妻子普罗旺斯的桑奇亚被加冕为亚琛大教堂德意志人的国王和皇后.
te: Richard of Cornwall, and his wife, Sanchia of Provence, are crowned King and Queen of the Germans at Aachen Cathedral.
dz: 康沃尔的理查德和他的妻子普罗旺斯的桑奇亚被加冕为亚琛大教堂德意志人的国王和皇后.
de: Richard of Cornwall, and his wife, Sanchia of Provence, are crowned King and Queen of the Germans at Aachen Cathedral.

t: 约翰被加冕为英格兰国王.
te: John is crowned King of England.
dz: 约翰被加冕为英格兰国王.
de: John is crowned King of England.

t: 马尔科姆四世成为苏格兰国王.
te: Malcolm IV becomes King of Scotland.
dz: 马尔科姆四世成为苏格兰国王.
de: Malcolm IV becomes King of Scotland.

t: 卡普亚的理查克三世被授以"王子"的称号,在他不适时地去世两周前.
te: Richard III of Capua is anointed as Prince two weeks before his untimely death.
dz: 卡普亚的理查克三世被授以"王子"的称号,在他不适时地去世两周前.
de: Richard III of Capua is anointed as Prince two weeks before his untimely death.

t: 埃米乔伯爵进入美因茨,他的追随者在那里屠杀了犹太公民. 至少600名犹太人被杀死.
te: Count Emicho enters Mainz, where his followers massacre Jewish citizens. At least 600 Jews are killed.
dz: 埃米乔伯爵进入美因茨,他的追随者在那里屠杀了犹太公民. 至少600名犹太人被杀死.
de: Count Emicho enters Mainz, where his followers massacre Jewish citizens. At least 600 Jews are killed.
